thread:
maria (Support): Customer (Acme) reported their JSON ingester is failing on our structured output. They say it was fine yesterday.

maria (Support): Repro they pasted (minimal):

```http
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "mode": "structured",
  "prompt": "annotate: ...",
  "stream": true
}
```

maria (Support): And the model output they got (raw stream reassembled):

```json
{"annotations":[{"id":1,"note":"C:\Users\Bob\notes.txt"},{"id":2,"note":"Quote: "unfinished"}
]}
```

devon (SRE): That second entry has an unescaped quote in the note ("unfinished) and the first has single backslashes from Windows path -- both will break JSON parsing. With streaming on, a trailing backslash at chunk boundary can also drop the escape char.

devon (SRE): Quick repro: try sending the same request with "stream": false; if it's valid then streaming chunking likely corrupted an escape.

raj (Eng): Can we get the request_id and model variant? Also need the raw streaming chunks (as text) or relay the trace id from the response headers.

ci-bot: Created ticket INF-10432 for this thread, assigned to eng oncall.

maria (Support): Request id from customer: req_01Hxyz. Model: redwood-v1. Variant: default. They say they use a node client that pipes chunks into a file and then JSON.parse(file).

devon (SRE): If the client concatenates chunks naively and a chunk ends with a single backslash (\) the next chunk may start with "n" -> becomes "\n" vs if split it can be "\"+"n" or could drop one backslash. We should verify our stream doesn't break multi-byte sequences or escape sequences across boundaries.

raj (Eng): Short term workaround for customer: disable streaming or post-process to re-escape backslashes and quotes before parse. Example (bash):

```bash
# naive re-escape before parsing
cat output.ndjson | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"unfinished/\"unfinished/g' > fixed.json
```

raj (Eng): Longer term: I'll add a streaming test that injects backslash+quote sequences at chunk boundaries against our chunker. Also add a flag to the runtime to never emit a single trailing backslash at end-of-chunk when streaming structured mode.

devon (SRE): Can you grab the router logs for req_01Hxyz? I'm seeing a few other similar errors in the last 48h but low volume.

maria (Support): Uploaded logs from customer and their ingestion error stack to the ticket.

raj (Eng): Escalating to runtime team. Assigning @devon to follow traces. Will report back with a repro harness and a patch plan.

maria (Support): Thanks — passing workaround to customer (disable stream or escape on client). keeping ticket open.
